'''Garcia''' (Japanese: '''ガルシア''' ''Garcia'') is a character in the [[Pokémon Adventures]] {{pkmn|manga}}. She is a resident of [[Vaniville Town]] who works at a grocery store.

==History==
Garcia debuted in ''[[PS573|Gathering Klefki]]''. She was one of the people who were kidnapped by [[Team Flare]] after attempting to escape from the destruction of Vaniville Town caused by the battle between [[Xerxer|Xerneas]] and {{p|Yveltal}}. Garcia and the other kidnapped Vaniville Town residents were taken to the [[Team Flare Secret HQ]], where they were locked inside jail cells.

When Team Flare began the operation to retrieve the dormant tree form of Xerneas, [[Celosia]] used her {{p|Aegislash}} to mind control the Vaniville townspeople in order to use them for slave labor. The townspeople were taken to {{rt|8|Kalos}}, where they were made to load Xerneas's tree form into a vehicle so that it can be moved to Team Flare's base. Garcia was freed from the mind control when [[Korrina]] battled against Celosia and defeated Aegislash with her {{TP|Korrina|Lucario}}.

Afterward, Garcia and the other Vaniville townspeople were taken to a [[Laverre City]] hospital to recuperate.

==Trivia==
* According to [[Satoshi Yamamoto]], several of the Vaniville Town residents are a reference to the long-running television series, {{wp|Criminal Minds}}. Garcia's design is a reference to the character {{wp|Penelope Garcia}}.<ref>[https://twitter.com/satoshi_swalot/status/1012299343255097344 Yamamoto's tweet]<sub>(Japanese)</sub></ref>
